description: pos_weight_for_bce is used with BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=...) to upweight the minority class (real). Since label=1 means fake, and fake is the majority, we actually want to upweight real. For BCEWithLogitsLoss, pos_weight > 1 upweights the positive class (fake=1). Since real is the minority, we use the INVERSE: weight for label=1 (fake) should be < 1, equivalent to giving real higher weight. USE the class_weights_tensor in CrossEntropyLoss or the pos_weight in BCE.
